mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate level consistently compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates and reduced corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS declining), reduced discount rates and improved risk appetite generate positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) combined with strong real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST > 1550.0 and RSAFS > 650000.0 fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of cases.
